package.name: chassis_guard
package.description: Reactive obstacle-avoidance guard for the wheeltec chassis during voice/keyboard manual driving. Sits on /cmd_vel as an overlay: external velocity commands are captured as an "intent", a local dynamic map built from the 2D lidar (with a reserved PointCloud2 input for future vision fusion) is used to steer around obstacles, and the original heading is automatically resumed once the path is clear.
